items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He introduced me, and Hilton Jefferson asked me did I want a job.

ctx.x: The job had just closed, Chez Paree or Chez Florence just closed, and I'm standing under there.

And a fellow, Benny James, a guitar player, he walks up to me, and he's pulling Hilton Jefferson with him, he's got him by the hand. He said, "Here's the man. This is the man you want. This man." He's pointing at me, you know. So he introduced Hilton Jefferson to me, which I knew Hilton but I didn't know him to speak to. He introduced me, and Hilton Jefferson asked me did I want a job. I says, "Yeah, I ain't doin' nothing." He said, "Well, I have a job in Brooklyn, at a nightclub in Brooklyn. If you want it, you…

And this other fellow, Benny James, was on the job, and ...(?)... So we go over there together, to the job. Well, this place was run by gangsters, naturally. It was all right with me. I liked to work with gangsters.
